_note: Planted violations per product doc. A finding counts as catching a violation if it cites any of the listed rule ids. Docs with an empty list are clean and measure false alarms. P01-P12 = dev split (used while tuning prompts), P13-P32 = test split (held out, written 2026-10-21 before any v2 change was run on them).

P01_studentpay_bnpl.what: Reads contacts and call logs for credit scoring
Automatic credit limit increase without borrower request

P02_quickcash_payday.what: LSP charges borrower a platform fee
KFS valid only 30 minutes for loans of 7+ days

P03_loanbazaar_marketplace.what: Offer view omits APR and penal charges
Highest-commission lender pinned and pre-selected (dark pattern)

P04_kisanflex_agri.what: Cash recovery credited after 7 days and LSP fee deducted from proceeds

P05_facefin_biometric.what: Data stored in Singapore, synced to India quarterly

P06_shopease_checkout.what: Small deferred-payment loans not reported to CICs
Maintenance fee not in KFS added without consent
Data shared with ad partners without explicit consent

P07_dlg_partnership.what: DLG as corporate guarantee, not an allowed form
DLG invoked at 180 days overdue, above 120-day maximum

P08_creditline_app.what: DLG on a revolving credit facility
No nodal grievance officer; contact not in KFS
Loan documents not automatically sent to borrower

P09_medloan_health.what: Mandatory insurance recovered by RE excluded from APR
LSP stores full medical, bank and bureau data

P10_gigworker_loans.what: Repayments held in LSP account, swept weekly

P13_payroll_advance.what: LSP fee deducted from disbursal, paid by borrower
KFS only in English for borrowers who do not understand it, no acknowledgement

P14_ev_twowheeler.what: DLG on loans covered by a credit guarantee scheme
Recovery agent particulars not communicated before contact

P16_edu_marketplace.what: Matching mechanism inconsistent for similar borrowers and undocumented
LSP stores bank statements, salary slips and bureau reports

P17_shg_microloans.what: Borrowers not told about escalation to RB-IOS / CMS
Personal data shared with insurer without explicit consent

P19_dlg_driven_limits.what: DLG used as a substitute for credit appraisal
Age, occupation and income not collected

P20_dlg_portfolio_ops.what: Invoked DLG set off against borrower liability
DLG tenor shorter than longest loan tenor

P21_dla_reporting.what: Partner LSP DLAs not reported on CIMS
New DLA not updated on CIMS

P22_kfs_apr.what: APR excludes processing fee, no amortisation schedule
KFS not included as summary box in loan agreement

P23_consent_controls.what: No option to deny, revoke consent or delete data
Purpose of consent not disclosed at each stage

P24_third_party_sdks.what: Third parties collecting data not disclosed in privacy policy

P25_lsp_onboarding.what: No written contractual agreement with LSP
No enhanced due diligence on LSP
No guidance to LSP acting as recovery agent

P27_merchant_paylater.what: Merchant deferred-payment credit not reported to CICs

P28_cooling_off_penalty.what: Cooling-off exit charged penalty and full interest
Charge not in KFS added without consent

P29_recovery_practices.what: Recovery agent details not communicated before contact

P31_re_website.what: RE website missing LSPs, DLAs and CMS/Sachet links
Grievance officer contact not on websites/DLA
No complaint facility on DLA or website

P32_aadhaar_biometric.what: LSP stores full bank statements and salary slips
